descriptions.en: Activate [Spartan Stance], dealing ${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}% ATK) physical DMG every 1.5 sec to enemies nearby. Spartan Stance consumes ${cfg.args.physicalBurn} Stamina every 1.5 sec. It deactivates when Stamina is insufficient.
descriptions.zh: 开启【斯巴达战阵】，每1.5秒对周围敌人造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点物理伤害。每1.5秒消耗${cfg.args.physicalBurn}点体力，体力不足时解除【斯巴达战阵】。

descriptions.en: Activate [Spartan Stance], dealing ${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}% ATK) physical DMG every 1.5 sec to enemies nearby, stunning them for ${cfg.onHitEnemyBuffArgs.duration/1000}. Spartan Stance consumes ${cfg.args.physicalBurn} Stamina every 1.5 sec. It deactivates when Stamina is insufficient.
descriptions.zh: 开启【斯巴达战阵】，每1.5秒对周围敌人造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点物理伤害,并附加${cfg.onHitEnemyBuffArgs.duration/1000}秒短暂眩晕。每1.5秒消耗${cfg.args.physicalBurn}点体力，体力不足时解除【斯巴达战阵】。

descriptions.en: Activate [Spartan Stance], gaining ${cfg.args.defence}% DMG Taken Reduction, dealing ${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}% ATK) physical DMG every 1.5 sec to enemies nearby, stunning them for ${cfg.onHitEnemyBuffArgs.duration/1000}. Spartan Stance consumes ${cfg.args.physicalBurn} Stamina every 1.5 sec. It deactivates when Stamina is insufficient.
descriptions.zh: 开启【斯巴达战阵】，获得${cfg.args.defence}%伤害减免，每1.5秒对周围敌人造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点物理伤害,并附加${cfg.onHitEnemyBuffArgs.duration/1000}秒短暂眩晕。每1.5秒消耗${cfg.args.physicalBurn}点体力，体力不足时解除【斯巴达战阵】。

descriptions.en: Regens ${cfg.HpShield} HP (${cfg.args.hpArgs}% of Nun's Max HP) per sec to allies within range for ${cfg.args.duration/1000}s. Passive: Healing effect of Nun's weapons and gears is improved by 50%

descriptions.zh: 立即回复范围内友方${cfg.HpShield2}点生命值（${cfg.args.hpArgs2}%修女最大生命值），并在接下来的${cfg.args.duration/1000}秒内每秒回复${cfg.HpShield}点生命值（${cfg.args.hpArgs}%修女最大生命值）。被动：修女武器及装备造成的治疗效果增加50%

descriptions.en: Restores ${cfg.HpShield2} HP (${cfg.args.hpArgs2}% of Nun's Max HP), inflicts ${cfg.args.defence}% DMG Reduction, and regens ${cfg.HpShield} HP (${cfg.args.hpArgs}% of Nun's Max HP) per sec to allies within range for ${cfg.args.duration/1000}s. Passive: Healing effect of Nun's weapons and gears is improved by 50%
descriptions.zh: 立即回复范围内友方${cfg.HpShield2}点生命值（${cfg.args.hpArgs2}%修女最大生命值），并在接下来的${cfg.args.duration/1000}秒获内获得${cfg.args.defence}%减伤效果，每秒回复${cfg.HpShield}点生命值（${cfg.args.hpArgs}%修女最大生命值）。被动：修女武器及装备造成的治疗效果增加50%

descriptions.en: Necromancer summons an Imp to fight for him until being slayed. It takes ${cfg.args.shareDMG}% of DMG Taken for its master. Its stats grow as Necromancer levels up
descriptions.zh: 亡灵术士从地狱召唤一只小型恶魔协助攻击，并帮英雄承担${cfg.args.shareDMG}%所受伤害，恶魔持续存在直至死亡。（恶魔的等级与亡灵术士的等级相关）

descriptions.en: Necromancer summons a Felfiend with [Lifesteal] to fight for him until being slayed. It takes ${cfg.args.shareDMG}% of DMG Taken for its master. Its stats grow as Necromancer levels up
descriptions.zh: 亡灵术士从地狱召唤一只中型恶魔协助攻击，并帮英雄承担${cfg.args.shareDMG}%所受伤害，恶魔获得攻击吸血，持续存在直至死亡。（恶魔的等级与亡灵术士的等级相关）

descriptions.en: Necromancer summons an Overfiend with [Lifesteal] and [Immune to Control] to fight for him until being slayed. It takes ${cfg.args.shareDMG}% of DMG Taken for its master. Its stats grow as Necromancer levels up
descriptions.zh: 亡灵术士从地狱召唤一只大型恶魔协助攻击，并帮英雄承担${cfg.args.shareDMG}%所受伤害，恶魔获得控制免疫及攻击吸血，持续存在直至死亡。（恶魔的等级与亡灵术士的等级相关）

descriptions.en: Provides a ${cfg.HpShield} (${cfg.args.hpArgs}% of Max HP) Shield for friendly units nearby, lasting ${cfg.args.duration/1000} seconds
descriptions.zh: 为自身周围的己方单位提供一个${cfg.HpShield}(${cfg.args.hpArgs}%最大生命值)的护盾，护盾持续${cfg.args.duration/1000}秒

descriptions.en: Removes most CC and Debuff Effects on friendly units nearby. Provides a ${cfg.HpShield} (${cfg.args.hpArgs}% of Max HP) Shield for them, lasting ${cfg.args.duration/1000} seconds
descriptions.zh: 为自身周围的己方单位解除其身上控制及绝大部分负面效果，并提供一个${cfg.HpShield}(${cfg.args.hpArgs}%最大生命值)的护盾，护盾持续${cfg.args.duration/1000}秒

descriptions.en: Becomes invincible for ${cfg.args.duration/1000} seconds. Remove most CC and Debuff Effects on friendly units nearby. Provides a ${cfg.HpShield} (${cfg.args.hpArgs}% of Max HP) Shield for them, lasting ${cfg.args.duration/1000} seconds
descriptions.zh: 自身获得持续${cfg.args.duration/1000}秒的无敌效果，为自身周围的友方单位解除其身上控制及绝大部分负面效果，并提供一个${cfg.HpShield}(${cfg.args.hpArgs}%最大生命值)的护盾，护盾持续${cfg.args.duration/1000}秒【无敌：不受伤害】

descriptions.en: Release ${cfg.args.num} explosive scarabs. Each scarab deals ${cfg.args.damage/100} DMG. Release an extra scarab for every 1000 Max HP Mummy has.
descriptions.zh: 向前方释放${cfg.args.num}只圣甲虫进行自爆攻击，每只圣甲虫造成${cfg.args.damage/100}点范围伤害。每有1000最大生命值，可额外释放1只圣甲虫。

descriptions.en: Release ${cfg.args.num} explosive scarabs. Each scarab deals ${cfg.args.damage/100} DMG, restoring ${cfg.DamageHealth} HP for Mummy. Release an extra scarab for every 1000 Max HP Mummy has.
descriptions.zh: 向前方释放${cfg.args.num}只圣甲虫进行自爆攻击，每只圣甲虫造成${cfg.args.damage/100}点范围伤害，并为木乃伊提供${cfg.DamageHealth}点生命回复。每有1000最大生命值，可额外释放1只圣甲虫。

descriptions.en: Release ${cfg.args.num} explosive scarabs. Each scarab deals ${cfg.args.damage/100} DMG, restoring ${cfg.DamageHealth} HP for Mummy. Release an extra scarab for every 1000 Max HP Mummy has. Passive: Automatically release a scarab when taking damage; Cooldown ${cfg.args.passiveCD/1000} seconds.
descriptions.zh: 向前方释放${cfg.args.num}只圣甲虫进行自爆攻击，每只圣甲虫造成${cfg.args.damage/100}点范围伤害，并为木乃伊提供${cfg.DamageHealth}点生命回复。每有1000最大生命值，可额外释放1只圣甲虫。被动：被攻击时自动释放一只圣甲虫，冷却${cfg.args.passiveCD/1000}秒。

descriptions.zh: 国王呼叫皇家军团，召唤${cfg.args.Number}名皇家近卫和${cfg.args.Number1}名皇家弓手，皇家军团存在${cfg.args.duration/1000}秒（皇家军团的等级与国王的等级相关）

descriptions.zh: 国王呼叫皇家军团，召唤${cfg.args.Number}名皇家近卫和${cfg.args.Number1}名皇家弓手，皇家军团存在${cfg.args.duration/1000}秒。脱战时皇家军团每秒恢复${cfg.args.healRate}%血量。每有一名士兵在场上时，国王获得${cfg.args.defence}%减伤。（皇家军团的等级与国王的等级相关）

descriptions.en: Witch places a cauldron that spills a cloud of poison for ${cfg.args.duration/1000} seconds, dealing ${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}% ATK) Poison DMG.

Passive: For each Poison weapon equipped, ATK increases by +10%

[Poisoning: Deals ${cfg.BuffDamage}(${cfg.onHitEnemyBuffArgs.args}% ATK) Poison DMG and loses STA every sec]

descriptions.zh:
被动：击杀英雄后英雄、武器技能冷却缩减${cfg.args.heroSkillCD}%
忍者向前方瞬移一大段距离，向四周释放${cfg.args.num}个飞镖，每个飞镖对敌人造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点伤害,飞镖每造成一次伤害恢复自身最大生命值${cfg.args.hpArgs}%的血量，并对敌人造成${cfg.onHitEnemyBuffArgs.propValue}%的减速，持续${cfg.onHitEnemyBuffArgs.duration/1000}秒

descriptions.en:
Passive: +${cfg.args.attackArgs}% to ally heroes nearby
Bard's ${cfg.args.duration/1000}-sec performance regens ${cfg.args.hpArgs}% Max HP per sec and +${cfg.args.speedArgs} SPD for allies nearby
descriptions.zh:
被动：周围友方英雄攻击力提升${cfg.args.attackArgs}%
吟游诗人开始演奏，每秒回复友方${cfg.args.hpArgs}%最大生命值和${cfg.args.speedArgs}点移速，持续${cfg.args.duration/1000}秒。

被动：周围友方英雄攻击力提升${cfg.args.attackArgs}%

制作${cfg.args.num}道美食，食用后立即恢复${cfg.HpShield}点血量（${cfg.args.hpArgs}%厨娘最大生命值）并获得等量护盾值，效果持续80秒。

descriptions.en: Slime morphs into the nearest resource or monster (BOSS not included). When Slime breaks her disguise, she casts a pool of goo for ${cfg.duration/1000}s, dealing ${cfg.TotalDamage} DMG (${cfg.args.damage/100} + ${cfg.args.atkArgs}% ATK) per second. Recovers ${cfg.args.hpArgs}% HP if forced to un-morph due to DMG Taken
descriptions.zh: 幻变成为附近的资源或普通怪物。史莱姆打破变身状态时，不断向四周释放粘液，每秒造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点伤害，持续${cfg.duration/1000}秒。受到伤害导致变身解除时，额外恢复${cfg.args.hpArgs}%血量

descriptions.en: Slime morphs into the nearest resource or monster (BOSS not included). When Slime breaks her disguise, she casts a pool of goo for ${cfg.duration/1000}s, dealing ${cfg.TotalDamage} DMG (${cfg.args.damage/100} + ${cfg.args.atkArgs}% ATK) per second (Affected enemies -25% SPD). Recovers ${cfg.args.hpArgs}% HP if forced to un-morph due to DMG Taken
descriptions.zh: 幻变成为附近的资源或普通怪物。史莱姆打破变身状态时，不断向四周释放粘液，每秒造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点伤害，持续${cfg.duration/1000}秒（同时造成25%减速效果）。受到伤害导致变身解除时，额外恢复${cfg.args.hpArgs}%血量

descriptions.en: Slime morphs into the nearest resource or monster (BOSS not included). When Slime breaks her disguise, she inflicts 1.5s [Chaos] to enemies nearby and casts a pool of goo for ${cfg.duration/1000}s, dealing ${cfg.TotalDamage} DMG (${cfg.args.damage/100} + ${cfg.args.atkArgs}% ATK) per second (Affected enemies -35% SPD). Recovers ${cfg.args.hpArgs}% HP if forced to un-morph due to DMG Taken
descriptions.zh: 幻变成为附近的资源或普通怪物。史莱姆打破变身状态时，向周围施加1.5秒混乱效果并不断向四周释放粘液，每秒造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点伤害，持续${cfg.duration/1000}秒（同时造成35%减速效果）。受到伤害导致变身解除时，额外恢复${cfg.args.hpArgs}%血量

descriptions.en:
Passive: Fire DMG +${cfg.args.fireIncrDmg}%, Fire RES +100
Summons a small meteor. After 1.5s, the meteor hits the ground, dealing ${cfg.TotalDamage} (${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}% ATK) AoE DMG. Inflicts ${cfg.BuffDamage1} (${cfg.onHitEnemyBuffArgs.propValue}% ATK) DMG per second to affected enemies for 4s.
descriptions.zh:
被动：火属性伤害+${cfg.args.fireIncrDmg}%、火抗+100
召唤一颗小型天外陨石，1.5秒后陨石击中地面造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点爆炸伤害，同时对目标施加每秒${cfg.BuffDamage1}(${cfg.onHitEnemyBuffArgs.propValue}%攻击力）点伤害，持续4秒。

descriptions.en:
Passive: Fire DMG +${cfg.args.fireIncrDmg}%, Fire RES +100
Summons a medium meteor. After 1.5s, the meteor hits the ground, dealing ${cfg.TotalDamage} (${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}% ATK) AoE DMG, stunning enemies for 1s. Inflicts ${cfg.BuffDamage1} (${cfg.onHitEnemyBuffArgs.propValue}% ATK) DMG per second to affected enemies for 4s.
descriptions.zh:
被动：火属性伤害+${cfg.args.fireIncrDmg}%、火抗+100
召唤一颗中型天外陨石，1.5秒后陨石击中地面造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点爆炸伤害，附加1秒眩晕。同时对目标施加每秒${cfg.BuffDamage1}(${cfg.onHitEnemyBuffArgs.propValue}%攻击力）点伤害，持续4秒。

descriptions.en:
Passive: Fire DMG +${cfg.args.fireIncrDmg}%, Fire RES +100
Summons a large meteor. After 1.5s, the meteor hits the ground, dealing ${cfg.TotalDamage} (${cfg.args.damage/100} + ${cfg.args.atkArgs}% ATK) AoE DMG, stunning enemies for 1s. Inflicts ${cfg.BuffDamage1} (${cfg.onHitEnemyBuffArgs.propValue}% ATK) DMG per second and [Silence] to affected enemies for 4s. [Silence: Cannot cast active skills]
descriptions.zh:
被动：火属性伤害+${cfg.args.fireIncrDmg}%、火抗+100
召唤一颗大型天外陨石，1.5秒后陨石击中地面造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点爆炸伤害，附加1秒眩晕。同时对目标施加每秒${cfg.BuffDamage1}(${cfg.onHitEnemyBuffArgs.propValue}%攻击力）点伤害和【沉默】，持续4秒。【沉默：不能释放主动技能】

descriptions.en: Passive: Throws a bomb (2S CD) at the nearest enemy whenever he casts an active weapon skill, dealing ${cfg.TotalDamage} AoE DMG (${cfg.args.atkArgs}% ATK). When being defeated, throws multiple bombs around, and revives with 20% Max HP 3s later [Revive Cooldown: 30 minutes]
descriptions.zh: 被动技能：释放武器技能时自动向附近敌人投掷炸弹（2秒冷却），造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点伤害。阵亡时向周围抛洒大量炸弹，3秒后原地复活并回复20%最大血量，冷却时间30分钟。

descriptions.en: Passive: Reduces the cooldown of active weapon skills by ${cfg.args.initSelfBuffArgs[1].propValue}%; Throws a bomb (2S CD) at the nearest enemy whenever he casts an active weapon skill, dealing ${cfg.TotalDamage} AoE DMG (${cfg.args.atkArgs}% ATK). When being defeated, throws multiple bombs around, and revives with 40% Max HP 3s later [Revive Cooldown: 30 minutes]
descriptions.zh: 被动技能：缩短${cfg.args.initSelfBuffArgs[1].propValue}%武器技能冷却时间，释放武器技能时自动向附近敌人投掷炸弹（2秒冷却），造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点伤害。阵亡时向周围抛洒大量炸弹，3秒后原地复活并回复40%最大血量，冷却时间30分钟。

descriptions.en: Passive: Reduces the cooldown of active weapon skills by ${cfg.args.initSelfBuffArgs[1].propValue}%; Throws a bomb (2S CD) at the nearest enemy whenever he casts an active weapon skill, dealing ${cfg.TotalDamage} AoE DMG (${cfg.args.atkArgs}% ATK), stunning them for 0.3s. When being defeated, throws multiple bombs around, and revives with 60% Max HP 3s later [Revive Cooldown: 30 minutes]
descriptions.zh: 被动技能：缩短${cfg.args.initSelfBuffArgs[1].propValue}%武器技能冷却时间，释放武器技能时自动向附近敌人投掷炸弹（2秒冷却），造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点伤害和0.3s眩晕。阵亡时向周围抛洒大量炸弹，3秒后原地复活并回复60%最大血量，冷却时间30分钟。

descriptions.en:
Shift between a humanoid and a beast. HP bars of the two forms are independent. Dies if one form reaches 0 HP.
BEAST: + ${cfg.args.hpArgs}% Max HP and + ${cfg.args.speedArgs} Bonus SPD. Unable to cast weapon active skills. Basic attacks evolve into bites, dealing ${cfg.TotalDamage} DMG (${cfg.args.damage/100} + ${cfg.args.atkArgs}%ATK)
descriptions.zh:
可以在人形态和狼形态之间切换。两个状态都拥有独立血量，任意状态血量为0都会死亡
狼形态：额外拥有${cfg.args.hpArgs}%生命值和${cfg.args.speedArgs}点移速。不可使用武器主动技能，普攻进化为撕咬，造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点伤害

The GM-74 spawns with a Shield (Gadgeteer's Max HP) and fires Elemental Bullets (based on equipped weapons). descriptions.zh:
被动：击败怪物经验获取+${cfg.args.exp}%
驾驶GM-74战斗，持续${cfg.duration/1000}秒。期间获得控制免疫但无法使用武器技能，普攻射出高速子弹（子弹根据携带的武器变化属性）。GM-74拥有与工程师最大血量相同的护盾值，每${cfg.args.interval/1000}秒恢复最大生命值${cfg.args.shield}%的护盾、${cfg.args.staminaRec}点体力。工程师会在GM-74损毁时逃离。

descriptions.en:
Passive: Gain +${cfg.args.exp}% EXP by defeating monsters
Pilot the GM-74 for ${cfg.duration/1000}s, during which he is immune to CC but cannot cast weapon skills. The GM-74 spawns with a Shield (Gadgeteer's Max HP) and fires Elemental Bullets (based on equipped weapons). It regenerates Shield (+${cfg.args.shield}% Max HP) and +${cfg.args.staminaRec} STA every ${cfg.args.interval/1000}s. Gadgeteer exits his GM-74 when it is destroyed.

descriptions.en:
Passive: DMG Taken decreases (Max 30%), and Melee Weapon DMG increases (Max 15%) as you lose HP.
Lose HP to throw a big axe that does DMG (${cfg.args.atkArgs}% ATK + ${cfg.args.hurtPer}% of target's Max Hp) with ${cfg.args.suckHp}% Lifesteal. Stun target for ${cfg.args.stunTime/1000}s (DMG to monsters capped).
descriptions.zh:
被动：当前生命值越低，获得越多的减伤（最多30%）和近战武器伤害加成（最多15%）
消耗生命值向前方投掷大飞斧，对目标造成（${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力+${cfg.args.hurtPer}%目标最大生命值）的物理伤害和${cfg.args.stunTime/1000}秒眩晕（对怪物伤害有上限），飞斧有${cfg.args.suckHp}%吸血效果

Lose HP to throw a big axe that does DMG (${cfg.args.atkArgs}% ATK + ${cfg.args.hurtPer}% of target's Max Hp) with ${cfg.args.suckHp}% Lifesteal. Stun target for ${cfg.args.stunTime/1000}s (DMG to monsters capped).

消耗生命值向前方投掷大飞斧，对目标造成（${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力+${cfg.args.hurtPer}%目标最大生命值）的物理伤害和${cfg.args.stunTime/1000}秒眩晕（对怪物伤害有上限），飞斧有${cfg.args.suckHp}%吸血效果

descriptions.en:
Passive: Moving a certain distance creates a healing marsh,  restoring HP (${cfg.args.cureArgs}% of Wyvern's Max HP) per sec for allies and dealing (${cfg.args.hurt}% of Max HP) Ice DMG.
Active: Summon a thundercloud to attack the closest enemy every ${cfg.args.onceTime/1000}s, dealing ${cfg.TotalDamage} (${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}% of ATK) Thunder DMG for ${cfg.duration/1000}s.
descriptions.zh:
被动：每移动一段距离，释放一片水泽，为范围内的友方单位恢复龙语者最大生命值${cfg.args.cureArgs}%的血量，对敌方单位造成龙语者最大生命值${cfg.args.hurt}%的冰属性伤害
主动：召唤一片乌云，每${cfg.args.onceTime/1000}秒电击范围内最近的敌方单位，造成${cfg.TotalDamage}(${cfg.args.damage/100}+${cfg.args.atkArgs}%攻击力)点雷属性伤害，持续${cfg.duration/1000}秒

descriptions.en:
Passive: Recovers ${cfg.args.hpArgs}% of her Max HP per sec
Active: Link up with an ally to absorb ${cfg.args.hurtShare}% of their DMG Taken and provide them ${cfg.args.cureShare}% of her HP recovery
descriptions.zh:
被动：花妖每秒恢复最大生命值${cfg.args.hpArgs}%的血量
主动：连接一个友方单位，花妖为连接目标承受${cfg.args.hurtShare}%的伤害，自身恢复血量时，同时给予目标${cfg.args.cureShare}%的血量恢复
